Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in the third step (the second turn) by misinterpreting the chronological order of the dates. After receiving the data that Fleetwood Sheppard died in 1698 and George William Whitaker died in 1916, the Planner incorrectly concluded that "George William Whitaker died first" and stated he died "more than 200 years earlier." In reality, 1698 is significantly earlier than 1916, meaning Fleetwood Sheppard died first. The Planner failed to perform the basic comparison of the years (1698 < 1916) and drew the exact opposite conclusion from the facts gathered by the WebSurfer.
